MY STORY ADVENTURE

Choose a Story Character

Meet six picture characters or invent someone completely new.

Look, then try.

A grown-up can cut along the card borders. Choose a dragon, explorer, rabbit, robot, hero or bear. Give your character a name and a wish. The picture does not decide their personality: a dragon could be shy, and a small rabbit could be brave.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

An adult helps cut character cards. Keep small paper scraps away from younger children. You can draw, type or ask a grown-up to write your words.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

ACTIVITY 1

Meet my character

Draw your chosen character or invent your own.

ACTIVITY 2

Show a feeling

Draw your character reacting to something that happens.

Your ideas belong here. There is no score.

What are we learning?

A character’s wishes and choices help a story move forward. Describing actions gives readers clues about personality.

Prefer a worksheet?

Open the individual cartoon activity sheet to print or save. Use portrait orientation and fit to page.
